services.desc: The Ecology Centre rents out the upstairs room in the Lynn Canyon Cafe building. This room can hold 40 people classroom/theatre style or 25 people around tables. Our fees for 2026 are $40 per hour (+GST). Minimum booking time is 2 hours. Time must include set-up/clean-up. Payment is required upon booking. We require two weeks notice for a full refund less a $20 administration fee. Within two weeks of the booking date, no refund will be given.
